work_package: FF4 (Phase C): the FeatureFinderLFQ TOPP tool
scope: OpenMS4-topp src/FeatureFinderLFQ.cpp: registration, main_, the hills path rule, the error branches
method: The built executable runs the upstream TOPP_FeatureFinderLFQ_1 invocation and five more; outputs are compared with the retained expectation (decoded, upstream FuzzyDiff settings, ids skipped) and exactly with the Release FeatureFinderLFQ's (decoded featureXML with unique ids, TSV byte for byte, -write_ini line by line and decoded).
evidence_tier: tier 1 (retained output and executed Linux x86_64 Release tool); tier 3 for the cited branches
